answer: Epoch weight comes from one oasis, a finite pool that refills only when non-kin peers attest real work. A draw is allowed only after a ripple: the identity's last three attestations must cross three invite branches with no shared sponsor inside five hops. Each draw consumes a signal, a single-use nullifier for that epoch. Using it twice reconstructs the key and slashes every stake tied to that nullifier. One operator splitting into n clones still has one path and one nullifier, so the clones share a single draw instead of multiplying income.
